title: Parking; regulation.
bodyText:
(a) The department of transportation may regulate parking utilized by peer-to-peer car sharing at state airports.

(b) The counties may, by ordinance, regulate parking utilized by shared cars.
bodyHtml:
[§279L-11]  Parking; regulation.  (a)  The department of transportation may regulate parking utilized by peer-to-peer car sharing at state airports.

     (b)  The counties may, by ordinance, regulate parking utilized by shared cars. [L 2023, c 210, §1]
